newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals seen opening mixed.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals seen opening mixed.

text.p: COMEX and NYMEX precious were called to open mixed Monday, with gold and palladium firmer, and silver and platinum lower.
COMEX August gold was called to open up $0.50 to $1.00 an ounce from Friday's close at $322.20, after trading between $323.20 and $321.20 in overnight ACCESS trade.
Although physical demand and shortcovering boosted prices overnight, dealers said the outlook was still bearish.
In London gold was fixed at $321.35 an ounce on Monday morning, compared with $319.50 on Friday afternoon.
Bullion was quoted at $322.00/$322.50 by dealers.
COMEX gold stocks rose 3,730 ounces to 869,691 ounces Friday, while COMEX silver stocks rose 5,057 ounces to 179,660,349 ounces.
COMEX September silver was seen flat to off 2.00 cents an ounce from Friday's close at $4.36 an ounce.
On ACCESS September silver was last traded at $4.345 an ounce, off 1.50 cents from Friday's close.

NYMEX October platinum was seen opening flat to off $0.50 an ounce from the previous close at $395.70, while NYMEX September palladium was seen up $0.50 to $1.00 an ounce from Friday's close at $153.00.
